description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Caleb Williams completed 21-of-29 pass attempts for 269 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing 10 times for 65 yards and two touchdowns in a 59-37 Week 1 win over the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Williams was electric behind center to begin the season for head coach Ben Johnson, recording multiple touchdowns through the air and on the ground in the win. The dual-threat quarterback will look to offer fantasy manager a dynamic option in a favorable Week 2 contest against the Minnesota Vikings.
items.title: Caleb Williams posts four touchdowns in Week 1 win over Panthers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Kyle Monangai rushed 10 times for 100 yards and one touchdown while also catching both of his targets for 24 yards in a 59-37 win over the Carolina Panthers in Week 1.
items.impact: Monangai made the most of limited touches highlighted by a 61-yard rushing touchdown in the win. The second-year running back will look to take advantage of a risky Minnesota Vikings defense in Week 2 for fantasy managers.
items.title: Kyle Monangai reaches 100 yards in Week 1 win

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: D'Andre Swift carried the ball 18 times for 124 rushing yards and three touchdowns while also catching his lone target for 10 yards in the Bears' 59-37 Week 1 win over the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Swift led an impactful Chicago backfield attack in the season opener for head coach Ben Johnson, averaging 6.9 yards per carry in the win. The veteran running back will look to take advantage of another favorable matchup against the Minnesota Vikings in Week 2 for fantasy managers.
items.title: D'Andre Swift rushes for three touchdowns in Week 1 win over Panthers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Tyler Warren hauled in three of his five targets for 13 yards and one touchdown in a 41-23 Week 1 loss to the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Warren was mostly bottled up by a stiff Baltimore defense, averaging 4.3 yards per reception in the Week 1 loss. The tight end remains a primary pass-catching offense for head coach Shane Steichen ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.title: Tyler Warren finds end zone in Week 1 loss

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Jonathan Taylor carried the ball 19 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns while also catching three of his four targets for 23 yards in the Colts' 41-23 loss to the Baltimore Ravens in Week 1.
items.impact: Taylor was the lone bright spot in an underwhelming Colts offense to begin the season, averaging 5.2 yards per carry in the loss. The superstar running back will look to remain an impactful backfield option in Week 2 against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.title: Jonathan Taylor rushes for two touchdowns in Week 1 loss

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: The Titans D/ST allowed 23 points while failing to record a sack or a turnover in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
items.impact: The Titans were unable to offer much resistance on defense in the lopsided loss. Things won't get any easier as they draw a tough Week 2 matchup against the Eagles. They will not be a recommended fantasy option for that contest.
items.title: Titans D/ST struggles against Jets in Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Malik Nabers (knee) is officially active for Week 1 for the New York Giants against the Dallas Cowboys according to Mike Garafolo.
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) active for Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (undisclosed) exited early for the Los Angeles Chargers against the Arizona Cardinals Sunday.
items.impact: McConkey headed to the medical tent after suffering an undisclosed injury, hauling in five of his seven targets for 82 yards and one touchdown for head coach Jim Harbaugh.
items.title: Ladd McConkey (undisclosed) exits early Sunday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Seth McGowan caught his only target for no gain in the Colts' 41-23 loss to the Baltimore Ravens in Week 1.
items.impact: McGowan was one of many options in the Indianapolis offense that failed to make an impact in the Week 1 loss and can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a tough Week 2 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.title: Seth McGowan catches one pass in Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Ashton Dulin failed to haul in his lone target in the Colts' 41-23 loss to the Baltimore Ravens in Week 1.
items.impact: Dulin was one of many pass-catchers who failed to find success in Week 1, with the wideout best left off rosters ahead of a tough Week 2 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.title: Ashton Dulin sees one target in Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Laquon Treadwell failed to catch his only target in the Colts' 41-23 Week 1 loss to the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Treadwell operated as more of an afterthought in the Indianapolis passing attack for head coach Shane Steichen, with a difficult Week 2 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs up next.
items.title: Laquon Treadwell sees one target in Week 1

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Joey Slye made a 42-yard field goal and added an extra point in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
items.impact: Slye wasn't asked to do much in a game where the Titans struggled to move the ball. The veteran kicker will not be a strong fantasy option heading into Week 2 against the Eagles.
items.title: Joey Slye makes one FG in Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Drew Ogletree failed to catch his only target in the Colts' 41-23 loss to the Baltimore Ravens in Week 1.
items.impact: Ogletree was one of many disappointing options in the Indianapolis offense in Week 1, with the tight end remaining best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.title: Drew Ogletree sees one target in Week 1

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Gunnar Helm caught four of his five targets for 28 yards in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
items.impact: Helm tied for second with four catches while finishing third on the team in receiving yards. The veteran tight end will be a TE3 heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Eagles.
items.title: Gunnar Helm catches four passes in Week 1

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Elic Ayomanor caught one of his three targets for an 11-yard touchdown in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
items.impact: Ayomanor was quiet for most of the afternoon until he pulled down his 11-yard touchdown in garbage time with 2:40 left in the game. The veteran wideout will be tough to trust as part of a below-average Tennessee passing attack going forward. The Titans will face the Eagles in Week 2.
items.title: Elic Ayomanor finds the end zone in Week 1

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Calvin Ridley was not targeted in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
items.impact: Ridley was on the field but did not record any stats in the lopsided loss to New York. The entire Titans offense struggled in the contest, but Ridley's lack of participation is still highly concerning going forward. He can be cut in shallow leagues heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Eagles.
items.title: Calvin Ridley not targeted in Week 1

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Wan'Dale Robinson caught five of his six targets for 38 yards in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
items.impact: Robinson tied for the team lead in targets and receiving yards while leading the way with his five catches. The entire Tennessee offense struggled to move the ball in Week 1, which cut into Robinson's final stats. He will look to bounce back as a decent flex option in PPR leagues heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Eagles.
items.title: Wan'Dale Robninson goes for 38 yards in Week 1

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Carnell Tate caught four of his six targets for 38 yards in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
items.impact: Tate tied for the team lead in targets and receiving yards while finishing second in receptions in his NFL debut. The rookie receiver will surely have bigger games going forward, as the entire Tennessee offense struggled in the season opener. Tate will be a low-end WR3 heading into a Week 2 matchup against the Eagles.
items.title: Carnell Tate catches four passes in Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: The Ravens D/ST recorded two sacks, one fumble recovery, and one interception in a Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: The defense stood tall in the season opener for first-year head coach Jesse Minter, allowing less than 275 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look to take advantage of a favorable Week 2 contest against the New Orleans Saints.
items.title: Ravens D/ST stifles Colts in Week 1 win

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Tyjae Spears carried the ball three times for 12 yards and caught two of his four targets for 12 yards in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
items.impact: Spears operated behind Tony Pollard, who had eight touches. It was not a great day for the Tennessee run game, as the Titans were playing from behind for the entire game. Spears at least drew an encouraging number of targets in the passing attack. He will be a low-end flex option heading into Week 2 against the Eagles.
items.title: Tyjae Spears finishes with 24 all-purpose yards in Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Tyler Loop converted both of his field goal attempts as well as all five of his extra point attempts to finish with 11 points in a 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Loop capitalized on every opportunity for head coach Jesse Minter, finishing with a perfect stat line in the Week 1 win. The kicker will look to take advantage of another favorable matchup in Week 2 against the New Orleans Saints.
items.title: Tyler Loop racks up 11 points in Week 1 win

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Tony Pollard carried the ball seven times for 35 yards and lost one yard on his lone catch in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
items.impact: Pollard was quiet with the Titans playing from behind for most of the game. On the bright side, the veteran running back led the backfield with Tyjae Spears getting just three carries. Pollard will look to bounce back as a high-end RB3 in Week 2 against the Eagles.
items.title: Tony Pollard held to 35 rushing yards in Week 1

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Derrick Henry carried the ball 24 times for 144 yards and three touchdowns while also hauling in his lone target for 19 yards in the Ravens' 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Henry capitalized on a sizeable workload out of the Baltimore backfield, averaging an impressive 6.0 yards per carry in the Week 1 win. The superstar running back remains locked in as a reliable RB1 ahead of a Week 2 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.
items.title: Derrick Henry rushes for three touchdowns in Week 1 win over Colts

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Cam Ward completed 19 of his 32 passes for 140 yards and a touchdown while adding 21 yards on four carries in a 23-10 loss to the Jets in Week 1.
items.impact: Ward struggled in the loss, averaging just 4.4 yards per attempt. His touchdown pass came in garbage time with the game out of reach on an 11-yard catch from Elic Ayomanor. Ward will be a low-end QB2 heading into a Week 2 home matchup against the Eagles.
items.title: Cam Ward struggles in Week 1 loss

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Lamar Jackson completed 17-of-25 pass attempts for 324 yards and one touchdown while also rushing seven times for 40 yards, one touchdown, and one lost fumble in the Ravens' 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Jackson took advantage of a more explosive offensive playbook from first-year offensive coordinator Declan Doyle, accounting for touchdowns on the ground and through the air in the win. The superstar quarterback remains an elite QB1 option entering a Week 2 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.
items.title: Lamar Jackson surpasses 300 passing yards in Week 1 win over Colts
